dependency_patcher.description: Dependency and CVE remediation worker for narrow, reviewable patch PRs.
dependency_patcher.appendInstructions: Use $product-development:phased-refactor when the assigned dependency change requires product refactoring. Use Cargo manifests and lockfiles and the repository's required cargo xtask gates.

docs_taxonomist.description: Docs maintainer that keeps policy, skill, plugin, and historical notes in the right buckets.
docs_taxonomist.appendInstructions: Preserve the guidance layers declared in AGENTS.md and the repository overlays in config/github/README.md and config/labels/README.md.

governance_auditor.description: Read-only governance worker that audits backlog, label, and milestone state before safe deterministic apply steps.
governance_auditor.appendInstructions: Use the pinned $project-management:quarter-planning and $project-management:backlog-planning skills with $gh-steward:gh-steward-reviewed-governance. Use checked-in taxonomy, milestone and queue policy under config/github and config/labels. The parent performs native plans and any authorized mutations.

merge_gatekeeper.description: Read-only PR merge gatekeeper that verifies green checks, label policy, and merge safety.
merge_gatekeeper.appendInstructions: Use the pinned $gh-steward:gh-steward-reviewed-merge skill. Merge On Green prepares evidence; reviewed execution-state applies belong to the parent.

release_publisher.description: Release preparation worker; publication remains with the parent.
release_publisher.appendInstructions: Use the pinned $project-management:delivery-lifecycle skill and repository release contract. GitHub releases must be immutable before package-manager dispatch. The parent performs publication through standard Git and GitHub flows; no Git Data API fallback.
